newsitem.title: CHINA: China Res, Esprit form China JV.
newsitem.headline: China Res, Esprit form China JV.

text.p: China Resources Enterprise Ltd and Esprit Holdings Ltd said on Thursday they intended to form a joint venture in China to manufacture and distribute consumer goods including the Esprit brand products.

The two companies said in a joint statement that the initial investment in the joint venture would be HK$300 million, with China Resources holding a 60 percent stake and Esprit holding the remaining 40 percent in the new firm.
"This joint venture is an important step in China Resources Enterprise's plan to establish retail distribution business in China," Frank Ning, managing director of China Resources, in the statement.

Michael Ying, chairman of the fashion distributor and wholesaler, said the joint venture would further help launching Esprit, which has about 100 outlets in China and plans to open to another 100 in the coming 12 to 18 months, into the China market.
"We are very excited about this joint venture, as the potential for Esprit products in China is huge," Ying said in the statement.
"China Resources Enterprise will provide us with strong support in the China market and enhance aggressive expansion of Esprit's business in the country," he said.
In July, Esprit formed a joint venture with Taka-Q Co Ltd to operate shops in Japan selling women's and children's apparel.
The joint venture firm has a starting capital of 200 million yen.
